reason: My son already goes to a pre-school tutor twice a week, and the core app is free anyway, so I'd install the free version and see if he even uses it before paying anything. 24,990 every month for an app on top of the tutor feels like paying twice for the same thing.
objection: I don't know if a phone app actually prepares him for first grade or just keeps him busy with games; the tutor I can see and talk to, the app I can't judge.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks on the free version the parent area showed me he really learned letters and numbers, and PRO had a clear first-grade readiness program that matches what the school will test.
